name: 方形圖片四欄網格＋置中說明文字
desc: 沒有標題組的單列網格，四個等寬項目並排，每個項目是一張方形圖片，下方置中放說明文字，所有項目樣式一致。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。沒有獨立的標題組，整個區塊是多個項目排成的網格，對齊頁面內容寬度，桌機每列四個項目，項目等寬並排填滿內容寬度。所有項目的組成與樣式一致：每個項目無外框，上方是一張方形圖片，所有圖片同一比例、頂端齊平，圖片佔項目的大部分高度；圖片下方是置中的說明文字（可多行），明顯比圖片矮。
mobile: 網格改為每列兩個項目，項目由上往下逐列堆疊；所有項目的組成與樣式仍一致，圖片仍為方形，說明文字仍置中在圖片下方。

en.name: Four-column grid of square images + centered captions
en.desc: A single-row grid without a heading group: four equal-width items side by side, each a square image with a centered caption below, all items styled identically.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. There is no separate heading group; the whole section is a grid of multiple items aligned to the page content width, with four items per row on desktop, equal in width and filling the content width side by side. All items share the same composition and styling: each item has no border, with a square image at the top, all images sharing the same aspect ratio with their tops aligned, and the image taking up most of the item's height; below the image is a centered caption (may wrap to multiple lines), noticeably shorter than the image.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The grid changes to two items per row, with rows stacked from top to bottom; all items still share the same composition and styling: the image is still square and the caption is still centered below the image.
